complete_question_object.question_text: Explain the complete natural water cycle and describe how human urban development alters groundwater infiltration rates.
complete_question_object.marking_scheme_answer: Water Cycle: Solar heat evaporates surface water from oceans/lakes into water vapor. Vapor rises, cools, and condenses into clouds. Instead of seeping into soil, rainwater turns into rapid surface runoff, leading to urban flooding and depleted underground aquifers.
